name: PPL Nav — Motorsegler SGS 2-33, EDNY Ausflug & Rückkehr

land.touchdown_cas_note: SGS 2-33 motor-glider has no spoilers and its motor idles at 0.45 min-throttle, so it flies final near cruise and touches down engine-off at ~1.7*Vs (still below its 17 m/s cruise) — the 1.5*Vs default is textbook for spoiler-equipped aircraft.
